summary: Amazon.com filed a routine 8-K reporting the September 14, 2026 closing of a four-tranche investment-grade bond offering under a February 6, 2026 Form S-3 shelf. The company sold 5.200% notes due 2029 (€1.25B), 5.550% notes due 2032 (€1.0B), 6.250% notes due 2038 (€1.0B), and 6.650% notes due 2045 (€1.0B), totaling €4.25B at an aggregate public offering price of €4.242B, with net proceeds near €4.235B. Notes were issued under a 2012 indenture with Computershare as successor trustee. No special-situation event arises; watch for leverage and buyback commentary.
